thread:
nina (Product Designer): heads-up: in the compliance panel the dropdown order and the KMS badge copy are tripping up a11y testing and legal. proposing compact labels and clearer CSV audit fields.

evan (PM): can you show the bad states? i ran a quick usability test and one user thought "Redwood" meant region, not key custody.

tess (Frontend): current markup: `select#region-picker`, then `span.kms-pill` with text `Redwood-managed key`. keyboard tab sequence: region -> kms-pill -> kms-tooltip. This means screen-reader users hear tooltip before they can change region.

raji (Security): also the wording `-managed` is vague in contract docs. security/legal want explicit custody words like `Redwood custody` vs `Customer custody (BYOK)`. we should avoid ambiguous adjectives.

omar (Backend): audit logs today look like: `user:alice updated kms_provider from redwood-managed to customer-managed (key: key-123)`. For CSV we export a single `event` column and some freeform `details` text. That makes parsing hard.

a11y-bot: automated-check: contrast-fail on `.kms-pill` (dark mode), tooltip-trigger not reachable with aria-expanded state missing, tab order flagged.

nina (Product Designer): proposal: 1) rename pills to `Redwood custody` and `Customer custody (BYOK)` 2) badge aria label to `Key custody: Redwood` / `Key custody: Customer (BYOK)` 3) move tooltip trigger after region in DOM so tab order = region -> tooltip -> actions 4) audit export: separate columns `kms_provider` and `kms_key_id` and keep `event_friendly` for UI messages only.

evan (PM): agree but legal may prefer `Redwood-managed` phrasing. can we keep `Redwood custody` visually and `Redwood-managed` in the accessible tooltip?

tess (Frontend): doable. implementation plan: change visible text to `Redwood custody` / `Customer custody (BYOK)`, aria-labels start with `Key custody:` and tooltip content contains `Managed by Redwood` or `Managed by customer KMS`. Reorder DOM: move tooltip trigger after `#region-picker` in the crypto row. estimate 1.5 days incl unit tests.

omar (Backend): I will change the audit pipeline to emit structured CSV columns `kms_provider,kms_key_id,event_friendly` and leave the old `details` column for one release before deprecating. Also will add a migration note. estimate 1 day + QA.

raji (Security): please ensure `kms_provider` values are stable (`redwood`,`customer_byok`) and document in the audit schema. Also confirm we don't leak full KMS key IDs in UI exports (masking needed).

a11y-bot: suggestion: tooltip triggers should have `role=button aria-expanded=false` and `aria-describedby` pointing to the long description. Screen reader text: `Key custody: Customer (BYOK). More info`

nina (Product Designer): UX nit for the pill: use medium weight to improve contrast in dark mode and add 2px outline token `border-critical` fallback. I'll update Figma and include the exact aria examples: `aria-label="Key custody: Customer (BYOK)"` and the tooltip longdesc id.

evan (PM): timeline: need copy freeze for legal review by Tue EOD. Nina, can you post the Figma frames + copy by Monday morning?

tess (Frontend): will open a WIP PR with DOM reorder + aria changes and a11y checks. tagging `i18n:extract` per ops-bot.

omar (Backend): will coordinate CSV schema changes with analytics and add export versioning.

raji (Security): minor: audit UI message for humans should be `Key custody changed: Redwood -> Customer (BYOK)` (Title case) and we should keep machine event `kms_provider_change` for logs.

nina (Product Designer): perfect. action items recap in one message: Figma + copy (nina), frontend PR (tess), audit export migration (omar), schema docs + values (raji). I will also include legal-friendly alternates: `Redwood-managed` vs `Redwood custody` in the spec.

evan (PM): thanks team. small follow-up: tess/omar, please add smoke test to ensure CSV backwards compatibility.

tess (Frontend): will do — adding unit test for tabbable order and aria attributes.

omar (Backend): adding CSV preservation test as well.

a11y-bot: reminder: after deploy, run automated screen reader runbook `sr-check-compliance-panel`.

nina (Product Designer): thanks all — i'll file the design spec PR and ping legal + accessibility in the thread. :sparkles:
